evidence.quote: In this paper we investigate the problem of designing protocols for resource allocation involving selfish agents.

evidence.quote: We derive a protocol that implements our mechanism and present experiments to show its effectiveness.

evidence.quote: We prove that by using the optimal allocation algorithm the output function admits a truthful payment scheme satisfying voluntary participation.

records.adjudication_reason: B retains only the payment result. The abstract also explicitly studies resource-allocation protocols involving selfish agents and derives a protocol implementing the load-balancing mechanism. This is specified coordination of agents in a distributed resource-allocation task, rather than one bidder optimizing independently, so L3 is also established.
